The company shows healthy liquidity (current ratio 1.55) and strong operating profitability (EBIT/Revenue ≈ 48%), which supports debt service capacity. However, leverage is high with total liabilities at ~79% of total assets and equity only ~21% of assets, indicating weaker balance-sheet resilience. Overall, this merits a speculative-grade rating at the higher end.

DECISION: BB+
